name: High-Contrast Cyberpunk & Mission Control Terminal
designThesis: Futuristic mission-control interface fusing retro-futuristic CRT telemetry with modern institutional command centers. Features deep obsidian backgrounds, phosphor neon accents, monospace telemetry streams, and hardware status indicators.
bestFitContexts: Algorithmic crypto and financial trading terminals
Cybersecurity SOC event and threat detection feeds
IoT fleet telemetry and robotics control consoles
Developer CLI and infrastructure logging dashboards
poorFitContexts: Wellness, meditation, and calm lifestyle apps
Legal probate documents and civic government forms

colorStrategy.accentUsage: Phosphor Cyan (#00FFFF), Neon Emerald (#10B981), and Terminal Amber (#F59E0B) for live telemetry indicators

typographyStrategy.fontPairing: JetBrains Mono or Space Mono paired with IBM Plex Sans for UI labels
typographyStrategy.hierarchyEmphasis: Uppercase sub-headers, dense monospace tabular metrics, and tracking-wide badge labels

layoutRhythm.gridStructure: Multi-pane split-screen console with fixed-height telemetry rows and sticky ledger headers

surfaceTreatment.borderStyle: 1px subtle luminous border (rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.2)) with scanline raster lines
surfaceTreatment.depthElevation: Layered terminal panels with dark vignette and subtle neon border accents

componentGuidelines.primaryActionStyle: Monospace command button with active state border glow and keyboard shortcut badge
componentGuidelines.cardStructure: Modular console tiles with status LED pills and real-time sparkline telemetry
componentGuidelines.tablePresentation: Dense monospace tabular figures with live value ticker animations and execution slippage flags

accessibilityProfile.keyboardHandling: Comprehensive terminal-style keyboard navigation with Cmd+K command palette and Vim keybindings
accessibilityProfile.reducedMotionRules: Disable pulsing glows and live ticker transitions for reduced motion preference

antiPatterns: Excessive CRT chromatic aberration that obscures text legibility
Flashing indicators faster than 2Hz violating seizure safety guidelines
Unbounded layout shift when streaming live tick data

browserChecks: Verify high-density telemetry streaming with zero layout shift
Verify neon contrast ratio against dark obsidian canvas
Verify keyboard shortcuts and command palette focus trap
